# Vendored browser libraries

- Bootstrap 5.3.3 — MIT — https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap
- Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3 — MIT — https://github.com/twbs/icons
- Chart.js 4.4.8 — MIT — https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js

Files are pinned distributions from jsDelivr; upstream copyright notices are retained. Google Fonts are loaded separately with local system-font fallbacks.
